# PabandiOS
> The trust operating system for bookings, freight, property, CRM, and finance.

## What we do
PabandiOS provides AI-powered reliability scoring, Solana escrow, and PAB reward 
distribution for service businesses. Five modules, one trust engine:
- BookingOS: Book services with trust protection
- FreightOS: Move goods with escrow-protected logistics
- AbodeOS: Manage property with tenant trust scoring
- PipelineOS: CRM and sales pipeline management
- LedgerOS: Finance, invoicing, and expense tracking

## API
- Base URL: https://api.pabandi.com
- OpenAPI spec: https://api.pabandi.com/openapi.yaml
- MCP server: https://api.pabandi.com/mcp

## Payments
We accept USDC on Solana via x402 and AP2-compatible authorization.
Agent escrow is available for all service bookings.

## Trust Score
Every agent can query the Reliability Score of any Pabandi Passport holder.
Endpoint: GET /api/v1/passport/{id}/trust-score

## Agent Discovery
- agents.json: https://pabandi.com/.well-known/agents.json
- Capabilities: booking.create, freight.quote, property.list, pipeline.ledger, escrow.initiate

## MCP Tools
- pabandi_verify_passport — verify PTP attestation
- pabandi_discover — platform discovery
- pabandi_get_ledger — audit passport issuance
- pabandi_issue_passport — issue agent passport (1.0 USDC)
- pabandi_verify_property — verify property documents
- pabandi_initiate_escrow — Solana escrow (0.5 USDC)
- pabandi_create_booking — create booking with AP2 (0.25 USDC)
